summary: Frontend-only testing of the Radar pinch/pan ScrollView-lock fix (4th targeted Radar fix this session). Zoom persistence via buttons/double-tap works correctly with no regressions (verified via testID buttons and dblclick - marker density/tier progressed 4->9->16->9->4 as expected across zoom-in x3, zoom-out, recentre, double-tap-in, double-tap-out). Filters/Radius/Events sheets open and close normally. HOWEVER, found a CRITICAL, consistently-reproducible regression in the new ScrollView/RefreshControl interaction-lock (radarInteracting) added for fix part 2: after a single pointer-down+drag+release on the Radar map, the outer ScrollView's overflow permanently gets stuck at 'hidden' (scrollEnabled=false) and never returns to scrollable, even after 600ms-7.7s of waiting and even after further unrelated interactions. Reproduced 3/3 consecutive trials via mouse-simulated single-finger drag (pointerdown/pointermove/pointerup), which is a valid way to test the documented onBegin/onFinalize wiring since RNGH-web listens on pointer events. Real two-finger pinch cannot be simulated in this Preview browser environment (known limitation, stated explicitly per instructions) — only the single-finger pan/ScrollView-lock path was verified, and that path is broken.

integration_issues.flow: Radar touch-interaction lock (radarInteracting) in app/(tabs)/index.tsx wired to RadarView's onInteractionStart/onInteractionEnd
integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL REGRESSION: After releasing a single-finger drag/touch on the Radar map, the surrounding ScrollView's scrollEnabled stays false and RefreshControl stays undefined FOREVER (does not restore). Reproduced 3/3 times: overflowY on the scroll container went from 'auto' -> 'hidden' immediately on pointerdown (correct, lock engaged) but never returned to 'auto' after pointerup + waits up to ~8s, and remained stuck for all subsequent interactions in the session (confirmed a follow-up drag below the Radar also failed to scroll the page). This means after the user touches the Radar even once, the whole Radar tab becomes permanently un-scrollable and pull-to-refresh is permanently disabled until the component remounts/screen is revisited.

action_items: Fix the radarTouchCount ref-counting bug: gestures = Gesture.Race(doubleTap, Gesture.Simultaneous(pinch, pan)) means BOTH pinch.onBegin() and pan.onBegin() fire on a single-finger touch-down (since Simultaneous tracks both concurrently before Race arbitration), incrementing radarTouchCount to 2. On release, only one of pinch/pan's onFinalize appears to reliably fire onInteractionEnd (pan does since it activates for a 1-finger drag; pinch likely never activates with 1 finger and its onFinalize may not decrement the same way, or fires with a race/ordering issue), leaving radarTouchCount stuck > 0 so radarInteracting never returns to false.

Recommended fix approaches: (a) track a single boolean 'touching' via GestureDetector-level onTouchesDown/onTouchesUp (native touch tracking) instead of per-gesture onBegin/onFinalize ref-counting across 3 separate gesture objects (pinch/pan/doubleTap), or (b) clamp radarTouchCount to never go below 0 AND add a safety-timeout/max-count guard, or (c) verify empirically (via console logging on native device/simulator, not just web) that pinch.onFinalize truly always fires paired with pinch.onBegin even when pinch never leaves BEGAN state for a 1-finger touch — if it does not, wire onInteractionStart/End only from pan + pinch.onStart (real 2-finger activation) instead of onBegin.
After fixing, retest: single-finger drag on Radar -> outer page must scroll again immediately after release, AND pull-to-refresh must work again on the very next attempt (not just eventually).
critical_code_review_comments: RadarView.tsx pinch.onBegin() and pan.onBegin() both call runOnJS(onInteractionStart)() unconditionally — for any single-finger touch inside Gesture.Simultaneous(pinch, pan), both onBegin handlers can fire, double-incrementing the parent's reference count. The corresponding onFinalize handlers are not guaranteed to be symmetric (pinch may never satisfy its 2-pointer requirement and could resolve without ever meaningfully finalizing the same way pan does), causing the counter in app/(tabs)/index.tsx (radarTouchCount) to never return to 0. This is exactly the kind of ref-counting fragility the fix should have avoided by using the GestureDetector's own touch lifecycle instead of duplicating start/end across 3 independent gesture recognizers.

success_rate.frontend: 70% - zoom buttons/double-tap/filters/radius sheet pass; critical ScrollView-lock regression found

seed_data_creation: None - used existing kauri@intro.demo demo account via POST /api/auth/demo-login
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: POST /api/auth/demo-login (empty body) -> token, then localStorage.setItem('auth_token', JSON.stringify(token)) and reload. Kauri starts 'Hidden' on Radar tab most sessions -> must tap 'Turn Visibility On' text button (get_by_text exact) before RadarView mounts. Ping popups ('Someone nearby wants to...') can appear over the Radar and block clicks -> dismiss via get_by_text('Dismiss', exact=True) in a retry loop before interacting. To test the ScrollView lock: find scroll container via document.querySelector('[data-testid="radar-map"]').parentElement.parentElement (2 levels up) and read getComputedStyle(el).overflowY + el.scrollTop before/during/after a page.mouse.down()/move()/up() sequence centered on the radar-map bounding box - this reliably reproduces the stuck-lock bug (3/3 trials). Zoom/double-tap verified via [data-testid=radar-zoom-in/out/recentre] and mouse.dblclick on radar-map center, checking the 'Showing your best N' focus-chip text which changes with zoom tier (4/9/16) as a proxy for scale/zoom state.
rca_of_issue: Gesture.Race(doubleTap, Gesture.Simultaneous(pinch, pan)) causes pinch and pan to both be live/tracked concurrently for any touch (Simultaneous means neither excludes the other before arbitration). Both gestures' onBegin() fire runOnJS(onInteractionStart) on touch-down, incrementing app/(tabs)/index.tsx's radarTouchCount ref from 0 to 2 for what the user perceives as ONE single-finger touch. On release, evidence (overflow permanently stuck at 'hidden' across 3 consecutive trials and multiple wait durations up to ~8s) shows the count does not return to 0 - i.e., only one of the two onFinalize callbacks is effectively decrementing it back down, or one of the two onBegin/onFinalize pairs is not symmetric for a gesture that never fully activates (pinch requires 2 pointers and likely never reaches ACTIVE/END state during a 1-finger drag, so its onFinalize semantics for a still-BEGAN, never-STARTED gesture may not mirror what onBegin assumed). Net effect: after the very first touch on the Radar, the outer ScrollView is permanently locked (scrollEnabled=false, RefreshControl removed) for the rest of the component's lifetime, breaking core scrolling and pull-to-refresh on the whole Radar tab - a severe usability regression introduced by this exact fix.
